title: Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor associated cough: deceptive information from the Physicians' Desk Reference
authors: Bangalore S, Kumar S, Messerli FH
followUp: at least 3 months in each included trial
population: 125 randomised trials published from 1990 with at least 100 patients in the ACE inhibitor arm reporting cough incidence or withdrawal for cough
funder: not read: the publisher page is not accessible and the PubMed abstract carries no funding statement.
result: Pooled weighted incidence of cough with enalapril 11.48% (95% CI 9.54% to 13.41%), nine times the 1.3% in the Physicians' Desk Reference and drug label; pooled withdrawal for cough with enalapril 2.57% (2.40% to 2.74%), 31 times the 0.1% in the label. Reported incidence rose over two decades but stayed several-fold below the trial data in the label; results were similar for most other ACE inhibitors. The authors expect real-world rates to exceed trial rates.
